capability_statement_anonymized: A specialized capability for authoring, building, and auditing NATIVE SKSE PLUGIN DLLs for Skyrim — C++ code compiled against the CommonLibSSE(-NG) library into a .dll that loads under SKSE. In scope: writing a new SKSE plugin from scratch (plugin lifecycle, event sinks that react to game events, code hooks/trampolines that patch the running game), exposing brand-new native functions to Papyrus FROM C++ (the C++ producer side of the function), making one DLL run across Skyrim SE/AE/VR (Address Library, multi-runtime discipline), setting up the C++ build toolchain (MSVC/CMake/vcpkg) for such a project, and reading an existing open-source SKSE plugin's C++ SOURCE to explain what its compiled DLL does. OUT OF SCOPE: editing record data in .esp/.esm files (armor/weapon/NPC/dialogue records), merging or ESL-flagging .esp plugins, writing .psc Papyrus SCRIPTS themselves (the script-language side / signatures), authoring distributor config files (SPID/KID/SkyPatcher .ini), diagnosing a user's game crash from a crash log, and end-user SKSE installation.
